g.aria-label: Why an Unmasked Multi-Layer Encoder Cannot Train on Next-Token Loss
Position t attends to key t + 1
which already read x_t+1 in Layer 1!
The MLM Rule (BERT): Remove Target Tokens from the Input Before Layer 1
Replace 15% of positions i ∈ M with <mask> (ID 256) and set unmasked labels to −100
so the network must reconstruct xᵢ purely from surrounding context!
